standard_prerequisites.name: The short exact sequences relating kernels, images and cohomology of a complex
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Standard: for a complex of abelian groups the kernel, the image and the cohomology fit into the two displayed short exact sequences
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the exact sequences used to propagate exactness from kernels to images and then to cohomology.

core_obligations: Exactness of the images (proof lines 7107-7114): the short exact sequences involving kernels and images, together with the exactness assumption on the kernels, give exactness of the complex of images in every degree.

Exactness of the cohomology (proof lines 7114-7121): repeating the argument with the short exact sequences relating images, kernels and cohomology gives exactness of the complex of cohomology groups in every degree.

The comparison on the total complex (proof lines 7124-7141): the author shows that the map on the zeroth cohomology of the total complex is an isomorphism, first that a cocycle is cohomologous to one coming from the first column, using exactness of the complex of cohomology, and then that two such representatives are cohomologous exactly when their images agree in $H^0(M^ ullet)$.
proof_roadmap: Propagate exactness from kernels to images using short exact sequences.
Propagate exactness from images and kernels to cohomology.
Compare the total complex with the target degree by degree on cocycles and coboundaries.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that if a complex is resolved by an exact complex of complexes whose complexes of kernels are also exact, then the total complex of the associated double complex maps by a quasi-isomorphism onto the original complex (statement lines 7089-7104). The proof is a complete argument: exactness is propagated from the kernels to the images and then to the cohomology groups through the two displayed systems of short exact sequences (proof lines 7107-7121); and the comparison on the total complex is carried out in degree zero by showing that every cocycle is cohomologous to one coming from the first column and that two such representatives are cohomologous exactly when their images agree (proof lines 7124-7141). The non-formal content is the two propagations of exactness and the comparison on cocycles. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
